# General settings
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo = FALSE}

# requires:
#
# tidyverse_2.0.0
# DESeq2_1.52.0
# pheatmap_1.0.13
# org.Dm.eg.db_3.22.0
# clusterProfiler_4.20.0
# conflicted_1.2.0

library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(org.Dm.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(conflicted)

# solve conflicts
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::rename)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::slice)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::desc)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::count)
conflicts_prefer(clusterProfiler::simplify)

```


### Files/ Path to files
```{r}
path_metadata <- "metadata/metadata.csv"
path_countfiles_STAR <- "Alignment/AlignmentSTAR"
path_immune_genes <- "metadata/Immune_pathway_genes"
path_immune_effectors <- "metadata/Immune_effector_genes/Immune_effector_genes.csv"
outpath <- "./Results/"

```

### Variables

```{r}

# for statistical analysis
padj <- 0.01
pseudocount <- 1
low_expression <- 10


# for plotting
mytheme <- theme(
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        #legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

color_red <- "#E83518"
color_blue <- "#2350a2"
color_scheme <- c("#969acc", "#f39e7c", "#b0d697", "#f8c18c", "#9f9fa0", "#c5aa80")
color_lightgray <- "gray90"
color_darkgray <- "gray70"

```

### Import metadata
```{r}

metadata <- read_delim(path_metadata,
                       delim = ";",
                       col_names = TRUE)  %>%
  arrange(library)


#make table for DESeq + order levels for testing
SampleTable <- metadata %>%
  mutate(condition = fct_inorder(condition),
         replicate = as.character(replicate)) %>%
  as.data.frame() 
        


```

### Import count data

```{r}


FilePath <- dir(path_countfiles_STAR, "ReadsPerGene.out.tab")
Files_STAR <- file.path(path_countfiles_STAR, FilePath)



countMatrix_STAR <- read_delim(Files_STAR[1], 
                           delim ="\t", 
                           col_names=FALSE) %>% 
  select("X1") %>%
  slice(5:n()) %>% #remove header 
  rename(Gene= X1)
  

#read in files 
for (i in 1: length(Files_STAR)){
  
  x <- read_delim(Files_STAR[i], 
               delim = "\t", 
               col_names = FALSE) %>%
    select("X1", "X4") %>%
    slice(5:n()) 
  
  Filename <- Files_STAR[i] %>%
    gsub(".*\\/|ReadsPerGene.out.tab", "", .)
  
  Dataset <- metadata %>%
    filter(library == Filename) %>%
    pull(Name)
  
  colnames(x) <- c("Gene", Dataset)
  
  countMatrix_STAR <- left_join(countMatrix_STAR, x, by= "Gene")
  
}

#Convert gene names to column names to convert table to matrix for DEseq
countMatrix_STAR <- countMatrix_STAR  %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames(var= "Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()




#Prepare sample table for DESeq2
# check manually!

rownames(SampleTable) <- colnames(countMatrix_STAR)

SampleTable
head(countMatrix_STAR)

```

### Get annotation data
```{r}

annotation_dmel <- AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Dm.eg.db,
        keys     = keys(org.Dm.eg.db, keytype = "FLYBASE"),
        keytype  = "FLYBASE",
        columns  = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME", "GENETYPE")) %>%
        rename(Gene = FLYBASE)

```

### quality controls
```{r}


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countMatrix_STAR, 
                              colData = SampleTable, 
                              design = ~condition)

vst <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

# plot PCA
plotPCA(vst, intgroup = "condition") +
        scale_color_manual( values = color_scheme )
    
# plot sample distance
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vst)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix( sampleDists )
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) = vst$Name
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) = NULL
colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(6, "Blues")) )(255)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
             clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists,
             clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists,
             col = colors,
             main = "Sample distance")
    
# plot Cook's distance
dds_qc <- DESeq(dds)
boxplot(log10(assays(dds_qc)[["cooks"]]), cex=0.5)
    
# plot Dispersion
plotDispEsts(dds_qc)
    

```
# Statistical testing

```{r}

# fitting model
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# testing, get results
results <- results(dds,
                   alpha = padj) 
    
# summarize number of DE genes
summary(results)

results_tibble <- results %>%
        
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        filter(baseMean > low_expression) %>% # remove genes that are not expressed
        replace_na(list(padj = 1))


# include annotation

results_annotated <- results_tibble %>%
        left_join(annotation_dmel)

# write to file
write_tsv(results_annotated, paste0(outpath, "DESeq_results_annotated.tsv"))
```

### Expression

```{r}

plotCounts(dds, gene="FBgn0262743", intgroup="condition") # plot Fs(2)Ket

# extract normalized counts for plotting
counts <- counts(dds,
                 normalized = TRUE,
                 replaced = FALSE) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% 
        as_tibble() %>% 
        # filter genes that are also in results object
        filter(Gene %in% results_annotated$Gene) 

# calculate mean counts for replicates
counts <- counts %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = -Gene,
                     names_to = "condition",
                     values_to = "counts") %>%
        mutate(condition = str_replace(condition, "_.*", "")) %>%
        group_by(Gene, condition) %>%
        summarize(mean_counts = mean(counts)) 

# get anotation

counts <- counts %>%
        left_join(results_annotated) %>%
        mutate(sign = ifelse(padj <= .env$padj, "significant", "not_significant"))

write_tsv(counts, paste0(outpath, "Mean_counts_all_annotated.tsv"))

counts_wide <- counts %>%
        mutate(log2_mean_counts = log2(mean_counts + pseudocount)) %>%
        select(Gene, condition, log2_mean_counts, sign) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = condition,
                    values_from = log2_mean_counts)



```
# Gene set enrichment analysis
```{r}

# only retain protein-coding genes
results_prot_cod <- results_annotated %>% 
        filter(GENETYPE == "protein-coding") %>%
        # sortung by Wald's statistic
        arrange(desc(stat))

# create gene list sorted by Wald's statistic
geneList <- results_prot_cod$stat
names(geneList) <- results_prot_cod$Gene

gse_results <- gseGO(geneList = geneList, 
               OrgDb = org.Dm.eg.db,
               ont = "BP",
               keyType = "FLYBASE",
               pvalueCutoff = padj)

# check results
dotplot(gse_results, showCategory=15)
head(gse_results)

# simplify GO terms to remove redundancy
gse_results_simplified <- simplify(gse_results, cutoff = 0.7)

dotplot(gse_results_simplified, showCategory=15)

# turn into tibble
gse_results_simplified_tibbel <- gse_results_simplified %>% 
        as_tibble()



gse_results_simplified_tibbel <- gse_results_simplified_tibbel %>% 
        mutate( Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "NES > 0", "NES < 0"),
                negLog10Padj = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(NES)))

write_tsv(gse_results_simplified_tibbel, paste0(outpath, "GO_results_all.tsv"))


# plot nicely
gse_results_simplified_tibbel_head <- gse_results_simplified_tibbel %>%
        group_by(Direction) %>%
        slice_head(n=12) %>%
        # truncate very long descriptions
        mutate(Description = str_replace(Description, "response", "resp."),
               Description = str_replace(Description, "negative", "neg."),
               Description = str_replace(Description, "regulation of", "reg."),
               Description = str_replace(Description, "chromosome", "chr."),
               Description = str_replace(Description, "chromatin", "chrom.")) %>%
        mutate(Description = str_trunc(Description, 30))


ggplot(gse_results_simplified_tibbel_head,
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description, desc(p.adjust)), # order by padj
           size = setSize,
           fill = negLog10Padj)) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.9) +
        facet_wrap(~Direction,
                   scales = "free_y") +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = color_lightgray, high = color_blue, name = "-log10(padj)") +
        scale_size(range = c(1, 8), name = "gene set size") +
        xlim(-3, 3.5) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, 
                   linetype = "dashed", 
                   color = "grey50") +
        labs(
                x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
                y = NULL) +
  mytheme 
  
# how many enriched go terms in upregulated (NES >0) or downregulated genes (NES < 0)?
gse_results_simplified_tibbel %>%
        group_by(Direction) %>%
        count()


# extract genes responsible for enrichment of immunity-related GO terms
gse_results_immune <- gse_results_simplified_tibbel_head %>%
        filter(NES < 0) %>% 
        arrange(p.adjust) %>%
        head(3) # first 3 most significant GO terms of downregulated genes are immune-related

descr_immune <- gse_results_immune %>% pull(Description)


enriched_genes_immune <- tibble()

for (desc in 1:length(descr_immune)) {
        
        go_term <- descr_immune[desc]
        
        # genes most enriched for go term
        genes_in_go <- gse_results_immune %>% 
                filter(Description == go_term) %>%
                pull(core_enrichment)
        
        genes_in_go <- strsplit(genes_in_go, "/")[[1]]  
        
        df <- tibble(Description = go_term,
                     enr_genes = genes_in_go)
        
        enriched_genes_immune <- rbind(enriched_genes_immune, df)
        
        
}

enriched_genes_immune <- enriched_genes_immune %>%
        group_by(enr_genes) %>%
        summarize(test = paste(Description, collapse = "; ")) %>%
        left_join(annotation_dmel, by = c("enr_genes" = "Gene"))

write_tsv(enriched_genes_immune, paste0(outpath, "Core_enrichment_immunity_go.tsv"))

```
# Immune pathways

```{r}
# plot log2 fold change of immune pathway components

file_path <- dir(path_immune_genes, ".txt")
files_immune_pathways <- file.path(path_immune_genes, file_path)

immune_pathway_genes <- tibble()

for (i in 1: length(files_immune_pathways)){
        
        filename <- files_immune_pathways[i]
        pathway <- str_extract(filename, "(?<=FlyBase_Fields_).+(?=\\.txt)")
        
        x <- read_delim(files_immune_pathways[i], 
               delim = "\t", 
               col_names = TRUE) %>%
                select(FBID_KEY, ANNOTATION_SYMBOL, NAME, SYMBOL) %>%
                rename(Gene = FBID_KEY) %>%
                mutate(pathway = pathway)
        
        
       
         immune_pathway_genes <- rbind(immune_pathway_genes, x)       
}

# get DESeq2 results
immune_pathway_genes_results <- immune_pathway_genes %>%
        left_join(results_annotated) %>%
        drop_na() %>%
        mutate(sign = ifelse(padj <= .env$padj, "significant", "not_significant")) %>%
        group_by(pathway) %>%                 
        arrange(log2FoldChange, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
        mutate(SYMBOL_ordered = fct_inorder(SYMBOL),
               pathway = fct_infreq(pathway)) %>%
        ungroup()


ggplot(immune_pathway_genes_results,
       aes( SYMBOL_ordered, 
            log2FoldChange,
            fill = sign)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        facet_grid(.~pathway,
                   scales= "free_x",
                   space = "free_x") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(color_lightgray, color_scheme[2]),
                          name = "",
                          labels = c("not significant", "significant")) +
        mytheme +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(0.1, 0.15),
              strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
        xlab("") +
        ylab("log2(fold change Fs(2)Ket vs WT)")


immune_effectors <- read_delim(path_immune_effectors, delim = ";") %>%
        select(Gene, SYMBOL, pathway) %>%
        left_join(results_annotated) %>%
        drop_na() %>%
        mutate(sign = ifelse(padj <= .env$padj, "significant", "not_significant")) %>%
        group_by(pathway) %>%                 
        arrange(log2FoldChange, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
        mutate(SYMBOL_ordered = fct_inorder(SYMBOL),
               pathway = fct_infreq(pathway)) %>%
        ungroup()

pathway_descr <- c("dominantly IMD", "JAK/STAT", "dominantly Toll", "cGAS-STING" ) # for manually changing facet labels
names(pathway_descr) <- levels(immune_effectors$pathway)

ggplot(immune_effectors,
       aes( SYMBOL_ordered, 
            log2FoldChange,
            fill = sign)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        facet_grid(.~pathway,
                   scales= "free_x",
                   space = "free_x",
                   labeller = labeller(pathway = pathway_descr)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(color_lightgray, color_scheme[2]),
                          name = "",
                          labels = c("not significant", "significant")) +
        mytheme +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(0.9, 0.15)) +
        xlab("") +
        ylab("log2(fold change Fs(2)Ket vs WT)")



# plot counts and colour in the immune pathway genes

# add description of immune pathway genes (for plotting)
immune_effectors2 <- immune_effectors %>% select(Gene, pathway )
immune_pathway_all <- immune_pathway_genes %>% 
        select(Gene, pathway) %>%
        rbind(immune_effectors2) %>%
        mutate(pathway = str_replace(pathway, "_dominant", ""))

counts_wide_immune_pathways <- counts_wide %>%
        left_join(immune_pathway_all) %>%
        replace_na(list(pathway = "no_immune")) %>%
        mutate(sign_pathway = ifelse(
                sign == "significant", pathway, sign
        )) %>%
        mutate(sign_pathway = fct_infreq(sign_pathway))



ggplot() +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "not_significant"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD, 
                           color = sign_pathway),
             alpha = 0.3) +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "no_immune"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD,
                           color = sign_pathway)) +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "cGAS_STING"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD,
                           color = sign_pathway),
             size = 3) +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "IMD"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD,
                           color = sign_pathway),
             size = 3) +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "JAK_STAT"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD,
                           color = sign_pathway),
             size = 3) +
        geom_point(data = counts_wide_immune_pathways %>% filter(sign_pathway == "Toll"),
             mapping = aes(WT, Fs2KetKD,
                           color = sign_pathway),
             size = 3) +
        
        scale_color_manual(values = c(color_lightgray, color_darkgray, color_scheme ),
                           name = "",
                           labels = c("not significant", "others", "cGAS-STING", "IMD", "JAK/STAT", "Toll")) +
        coord_fixed() +
        mytheme +
        theme(legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.25)) +
        xlab("log2( mean counts WT + 1 )") +
        ylab("log2( mean counts Fs(2)Ket + 1 )") 
        


```
